reviews.text: They don't leave it the way they're asked.

Be careful! I took my long-haired Chihuahua in for a trim and to have the hair on his rear end cut short because it sometimes got stuck when he relieved himself. I left him there, and they told me it would take three hours. I left because you can't stay there, and they called me back an hour and a half later, which I found strange. When they arrived, my Chihuahua's hair was short or shaved all over his body. When I asked them what they had done and that his breed is a long-haired Chihuahua, not just any Chihuahua, the young woman who attended me said that you had requested a trim on his rear end so it wouldn't look uneven. That was all. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THEM. BE CAREFUL! 👀 Their logic is very flawed, so watch out! 👁️ They are not trustworthy.
It's never open, and even when it is open, they don't answer.
They were very understanding of my pet's behavior. Thank you for being honest.
